title: Broken
body:
This used to be a great app which I happily paid for.
However, in the past year, the app has been reworked twice. Every time, this has broken functionality in a significant way.
At the moment, basic functionality like “logging a habit using custom count” has been broken for three weeks and counting. Emails to support are ignored.
I might need to look for a different app.

title: Best app to keep track on all my goals !! BUT…
body:
I highly recommend this app to anyone who is interested in keeping track on their goals and organizing their habits.
I love everything, but my only issue is that I can’t modify the sound activated when I log the completion of my habit. Currently it’s only the sound of the reminders that can be modified but the other sound, unfortunately I can only either activate or deactivate it. 
But besides that, the app is AMAZING! And probably for someone else this isn’t even an issue. But just leaving my input here and I am happy with the product either way. Thanks 😊

title: Bad update
body:
I hate the new widget. 
I used Done because the old style left pane widget was a button thing that didn’t require to open the app. Now, you’ve to open the app (slow) just to record a +1 on something. 
That’s a serious downgrade of the experience. 
Think I’ll look for an alternative now.
author: _lunch

title: Ideal for people with ADD
body:
As I have ADD, this app really puts my mind at ease. I manage my life by endless to do lists. Now I got rid of all of these and just use only this app instead. Its design is simple and easy to use. 

1000x Thanks for making my life easier!

title: Nice and easy
body:
I love the fact that it is so easy and simple to use. Visually it is pleasing and straightforward. Plus you don’t have to create a username, Which is Nice! For now the free version is good enough, but I might consider to buy the premium version. 

Keep up the good work!
